input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, MIN(trip_date) AS first_day, MAX(trip_date) AS last_day, CAST((julianday(MAX(trip_date)) - julianday(MIN(trip_date))) / 30 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS periods_30d, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS classic_min, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='ebike' THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_min, SUM(CASE WHEN bike='classic' AND duration_min > 45 THEN duration_min - 45 ELSE 0 END) AS classic_over45_min, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_min FROM trips
